{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since we are analyzing mean flipper length
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and calculate mean flipper length
mean_flipper_length = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_length.idxmax()

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_length)
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
